title: Bad review ka *jawab* naye customers padhte hain, review nahi.
message:
Sorry [naam] ji, [dish] ka experience aisa nahi hona chahiye tha. 🙏
Humne kitchen team se baat kar li hai. Agli baar aap aayein to *dessert humari taraf se*. Direct baat: [number]
why: naam lo, galti maano, *ek fix batao*, offline baat ka number do. Bahas kabhi nahi.
caption:
Google pe 1-star review. Gussa aata hai, par asli audience woh customer hai jo kal review padhega. 🍽️

Achha reply = 4 parts:
1️⃣ Naam + sorry
2️⃣ Kya badla (kitchen se baat ki)
3️⃣ Wapas bulane ka reason
4️⃣ Offline number, bahas wahan

24 ghante ke andar reply karo. Save karo 🔖

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
